items.title: WHI推出Nexus電話下單，AI接入既有Nexpart流程

items.summary: WHI Solutions於10月30日公布Nexus，首項功能為AI接聽電話及透過Nexpart下單，已在部分零件分銷商推出。
items.summary_en: WHI Solutions announced Nexus on October 30, starting with AI phone answering and Nexpart ordering at initial parts distributors.
items.why: 案例顯示B2B AI服務可從既有訂單入口切入，品牌仍需處理例外與客戶關係。
items.why_en: The case illustrates an existing-channel entry point for B2B AI service, with exceptions and relationships still requiring ownership.
items.next_step: 檢視目錄資料、錯單處理及轉人工流程，再評估同類場景。
items.next_step_en: Review catalog data, incorrect-order handling and human escalation before considering a similar workflow.
highlights: 系統沿用分銷商既有電話及訂單流程。
先支援英語與西班牙語，其他語言仍在開發。
highlights_en: The system uses existing distributor phone and ordering workflows.
English and Spanish are supported first; other languages remain in development.
items.detail:
WHI Solutions於10月30日公布Nexus，首項功能為AI接聽電話及透過Nexpart下單，已在部分零件分銷商推出。

系統沿用分銷商既有電話及訂單流程。

先支援英語與西班牙語，其他語言仍在開發。

案例顯示B2B AI服務可從既有訂單入口切入，品牌仍需處理例外與客戶關係。

檢視目錄資料、錯單處理及轉人工流程，再評估同類場景。

公告未提供獨立準確率或收入結果；已上線不等於全部客戶完成部署，亦未確認粵語支援。
items.detail_en:
WHI Solutions announced Nexus on October 30, starting with AI phone answering and Nexpart ordering at initial parts distributors.

The system uses existing distributor phone and ordering workflows.

English and Spanish are supported first; other languages remain in development.

The case illustrates an existing-channel entry point for B2B AI service, with exceptions and relationships still requiring ownership.

Review catalog data, incorrect-order handling and human escalation before considering a similar workflow.

No independently measured accuracy or revenue result is provided. Rollout is not complete for all customers and Cantonese support is unconfirmed.

items.title: Canva北美新廣告以日常創作故事呈現工具價值
items.title_en: Canva’s North America campaign puts everyday creation at the center
items.summary: Canva於10月30日介紹北美品牌企劃「What Will You Canva Today?」，以生活與工作情境連結產品用途。
items.summary_en: Canva’s October 30 North America campaign announcement uses everyday work and personal scenarios to explain product uses.
items.why: AI創意產品可用具體使用情境解釋價值，避免只展示功能清單。
items.why_en: AI creative products can communicate value through specific use situations rather than feature lists.
items.next_step: 選一個受眾熟悉的任務，測試以人物選擇串連產品示範。
items.next_step_en: Choose one familiar task and test a product demonstration driven by human choices.

首支電視廣告預定美國11月1日於NBC Sunday Night Football播出。
highlights_en: GS&P and the in-house team support television, outdoor, radio and social assets.
The first TV spot is scheduled for November 1 US time during NBC Sunday Night Football.

items.title: 案例補讀：Coty以Brandlight串連美妝內容與AI搜尋
items.title_en: Case review: Coty links beauty content with AI discovery through Brandlight
items.summary: Coty於10月27日公布與Brandlight合作，涵蓋生成式搜尋優化、量度、培訓及品牌團隊支援。
items.summary_en: Coty’s October 27 partnership with Brandlight covers generative-search optimization, measurement, training and brand-team support.
items.why: 美妝品牌可把內容、電商與公關納入同一AI可見度工作，而非獨立處理搜尋。
items.why_en: Beauty teams can coordinate content, ecommerce and PR within an AI-visibility program.
items.next_step: 選一條非品牌需求問題，核對商品資料與可追溯的第三方來源。
items.next_step_en: Choose one unbranded buyer need and audit product information and traceable external sources.
highlights: 公告把商品頁、創作者素材、digital PR及新品工具包納入早期試行。
合作重點包括非直接品牌名稱搜尋的產品發現。
highlights_en: The release includes product pages, creator assets, digital PR and launch toolkits in early pilot work.
The partnership addresses discovery beyond direct brand-name searches.
items.detail:
Coty於10月27日公布與Brandlight合作，涵蓋生成式搜尋優化、量度、培訓及品牌團隊支援。

公告把商品頁、創作者素材、digital PR及新品工具包納入早期試行。

合作重點包括非直接品牌名稱搜尋的產品發現。

美妝品牌可把內容、電商與公關納入同一AI可見度工作，而非獨立處理搜尋。

選一條非品牌需求問題，核對商品資料與可追溯的第三方來源。

此為10月27日公告的案例補讀，屬較早公告的案例補讀；試行未披露量化效果，不能保證排名或銷售。
items.detail_en:
Coty’s October 27 partnership with Brandlight covers generative-search optimization, measurement, training and brand-team support.

The release includes product pages, creator assets, digital PR and launch toolkits in early pilot work.

The partnership addresses discovery beyond direct brand-name searches.

Beauty teams can coordinate content, ecommerce and PR within an AI-visibility program.

Choose one unbranded buyer need and audit product information and traceable external sources.

This reviews an October 27 announcement, not a new deal today. Pilot results are unquantified and establish no ranking or sales guarantee.
